claim: Brighton Fringe board had all relevant safeguarding and legal information when making decisions regarding Ben Carter’s removal.
reality: A second crime reference number (47250152583) was issued by Sussex Police for stalking and harassment on 3 August 2025. This was submitted independently and without the knowledge of Brighton Fringe Chair Duncan Lustig-Prean, after the board refused to engage with Ben's disclosures or the initial police assignment (CR 47250093423). The new report was routed through policeplease.com, circumventing institutional obstruction.
laws_breached: Human Rights Act 1998 (Right to fair treatment and remedy)
